description: Per-release pins for drama-song-ad-factory. Directive 2.4: every release records core and adapter versions, artifact-schema versions, compatible Command Center API versions, source commits, dependency hashes and third-party notices, plus migrations and rollback. Multi-repo merges are not atomic: deploy compatible server changes first, then dependent clients. Instance lives at release time (W5-02); this file is the schema scaffold (W1-07).
